scenario: A state UI agency agent pipeline processes an appeal from a laid-off worker: it parses the employer's separation notice to extract structured claim details, applies state UI eligibility rules to determine whether the separation type is disqualifying, and produces a formal determination letter for the appeals examiner.
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json parses the separation notice PDF into a structured JSON record with a separation_code field → presale-regulation-auditor applies UI eligibility rules to the separation_code to produce an eligibility_status and disqualification_reason → reporting generates a formal determination letter summarizing the outcome.
